headline: The Select Board approved a $105,000 police drone package using year-end funds, while town boards advanced trail funding and paused wastewater studies.
synopsis: In a 3-2 vote, the Select Board authorized using surplus police department budget funds to purchase a $105,000 five-year drone package, partially offset by a donation from Fay School. The Wastewater Study Committee unanimously rejected spending $30,000 on an economic development study, opting instead to resolve environmental watershed restrictions on potential treatment sites. Meanwhile, the Recreation Commission voted to back Community Preservation Act funding for a bridge along the Peninsula Trail and selected a 33-space roadside parking layout for Fay Memorial Park. Commissioners also discussed a request to restrict athletic field permits on the morning of the October Special Town Meeting to encourage resident attendance.

highlights.title: Select Board approves $105,000 police drone package
highlights.why: In a 3-2 vote, the board authorized using year-end departmental surplus funds to purchase an Axon drone package, offset by a $20,000 Fay School donation, despite debate over bypassing Town Meeting approval.

highlights.title: Wastewater committee rejects $30,000 financial study
highlights.why: The committee voted 0-5 against funding a District Improvement Financing study, deciding it is premature to spend funds before confirming whether Sudbury Reservoir watershed restrictions permit a viable treatment location.

highlights.title: Recreation Commission backs Peninsula Trail bridge funding
highlights.why: Commissioners voted 3-0 to endorse the Trails Committee's revised Community Preservation Act application to fund a reservoir pedestrian bridge after Phase 2 bids exceeded budget limits.

highlights.title: Commission selects 33-space parking design for Fay Memorial Park
highlights.why: The Recreation Commission agreed to advance a 33-space Central Street parking layout over a costlier $312,000 option behind the park, while considering whether to delay its funding request to spring 2027.

highlights.title: Field permit restrictions discussed for Fall Special Town Meeting
highlights.why: Commissioners reviewed a Select Board request to restrict town sports field permits until noon on Saturday, October 17, to encourage attendance at the 10:00 AM Town Meeting.
